purpose: Root tabs composite that owns the active value and orientation and coordinates tab, tab-list, and tab-panel descendants via context.
useWhen: Switching between several panels of related content under one heading area.
Building the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with shared keyboard navigation and activation rules.

avoidWhen.reason: Picking one of two to five short values inline — use segmented-control instead.
Showing ordered progress through a wizard — use steps instead.
